goal: Replace the account-dashboard per-location fan-out with a set-based per-account aggregate (fixed GROUP BY business_id queries, location-count-independent) and window the two account-wide response-rate counts by the dashboard window param, with byte-identical output for every retained field.

glossary_coined.per-location fan-out: The current aggregate-service pattern of running the full per-location dashboard batch once per active location via mapWithConcurrency (~14 queries x N locations per aggregate page view). Being replaced.
glossary_coined.set-based per-account aggregate: A fixed, location-count-independent set of GROUP BY business_id queries producing every per-location slice the aggregate view consumes in one wave, bucketed by business_id and fed through the EXISTING per-location mappers (buildRanking, buildRatingBreakdown, buildValueSummary, brief-picking) so output is identical by construction.
glossary_coined.windowed account response rate: The All-Locations currentResponseRate computed over the selected dashboard window (reviews detected_at in window), matching reputationSummary.rate semantics, replacing the all-time COUNT(*).

non_goals: Do NOT touch getActiveDashboardData / the single-location dashboard path (service.ts) — it stays the per-location owner.
Do NOT change the account-wide LIMIT-20 recentReviews feed added by #487 (getAccountRecentReviews stays as-is).
Do NOT add a migration, index, or any schema change — read path only.
Do NOT change the 45s aggregate cache TTL/key behavior (only simplify the partial-failure cache gate now that failures are atomic).
Do NOT window per-location valueSummary.totalReviewsHandled — it stays all-time (byte-identical). Only the two account-wide totals feeding currentResponseRate get windowed.
Do NOT alter tenant-scoping rules or introduce RLS.
user_visible_behavior: All-Locations dashboard currentResponseRate becomes windowed by the selected dashboard window (30d default) instead of all-time; it will differ from the all-time rate on single-location cards by design.
partialFailures is removed from the AggregateDashboardData contract; the aggregate now succeeds atomically or the request errors (same failure surface as any DB outage).

Every other field (totalReviewsHandled, totalTimeSavedMinutes, baselineResponseRate, per-location KPIs, reviewVelocity, ranking, ratingBreakdown, recentReviews feed, perLocationBriefs, activeLocationCount) is byte-identical to today.
locked_decisions: Windowed-rate numerator/denominator defined to match reputationSummary.rate: denominator = reviews with detected_at in window AND status<>DELETED; numerator = distinct reviews with detected_at in window that have a HANDLED-status response. Scoped by account_id.
Set-based queries feed the SAME mappers the per-location path uses; the rewrite changes only the fetch layer, guaranteeing byte-identical retained fields.

The authoritative pending-count rule stays owned by pending-count.ts; a plural set-based function is ADDED there rather than duplicating the NOT-EXISTS-flagged-open predicate in aggregate code (one authoritative owner).

New module src/lib/dashboard/aggregate-queries.ts hides the set-based SQL + business_id bucketing behind a narrow interface; aggregate-service.ts stays pure composition. mapWithConcurrency (now dead) is deleted.
invariants: Tenant isolation: every aggregate query scoped by account_id via JOIN businesses b WHERE b.account_id = accountId; no cross-account leak (invariant #8; ci:tenant-scope).
Domain modules receive sql as an explicit parameter, never import @/lib/db/server (invariant #15; ci:db-imports).
Moderation hold respected: pending count and any response join exclude drafts with an open flagged_responses row.
Query count is independent of active-location count (the core perf guarantee) — constant number of sql round-trips per aggregate build.
Archived and DELETED rows excluded exactly as the per-location path does (b.archived_at IS NULL, rev.status <> DELETED).
edge_cases: Account with zero active locations: same all-zero AggregateDashboardData as today (early return).

Location with no reviews / no responses / no ranking / no brief: bucket absent from GROUP BY result -> mapper must receive an empty bucket and produce the same zero-filled slice the per-location path does (velocity zero-fill weeks, empty rating breakdown, null ranking, null brief).
recentReviewCount per location = LEAST(count of non-deleted reviews, 10) to reproduce the old sliced-array length exactly.
Window selector 90d/etc: velocity, ratingBreakdown, AND the windowed rate all move together off the same window param.
Primary-location baselineResponseRate: needs initial_review_count/initial_responded_count/baseline_captured_at columns (not in LocationRow) — fetch them set-based for the account.
detected_at vs review_date: windowed counts use detected_at (ingestion recency), matching the per-location windowed metrics.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/dashboard/service.ts velocity/ratingBreakdown/ranking queries (window params via dashboardWindowParams + make_interval; generate_series zero-fill) — reproduce with an added GROUP BY business_id.
src/lib/dashboard/service-mappers.ts (buildValueSummary, buildRanking, getBaselineResponseRate), rating-breakdown.ts (buildRatingBreakdown, sumRatingBreakdowns) — REUSE per business_id bucket.
src/lib/dashboard/pending-count.ts getPendingApprovalCount — add a plural set-based sibling.
Existing account-scoped counts getTotalReviewsForAccount/getTotalRespondedForAccount — window them in place.
worker/__tests__/helpers/mock-sql.ts fragment-aware createMockSql harness — used by the current aggregate-service.test.ts.
